text: …　おまえと　ポケモンも　いきが　あってるな

structure.jp: おまえと　ポケモンも
いきが　あってるな

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb shows a state that continues; here it is shortened to てる, as in casual speech. いきが　あってる = 'are in sync'.

patterns.name: 〜な (feeling)
patterns.explanation: な at the end of a sentence shows the speaker noticing something and saying it half to himself. あってるな = 'you're in sync, huh'.
